legacy_option.warning: The original exact-accelerated backend bypassed this option; adaptive_memory_preconditioning_v1 centralizes the recurrence and repairs backend parity.

math.conditioned_gradient: g_tilde = g_t * min(1, c_t / max(rms(g_t), eps))

rationale: Dividing the squared-error objective by d_model makes the inner gradient invariant to the arbitrary choice of feature-count reduction.
The RMS trust ratio is dimensionless and scales the admissible inner gradient with the current fast-weight scale rather than imposing an architecture-specific absolute surprise norm.
Bounding theta limits the learned write rate while retaining token-dependent adaptation.
Raw preconditioning diagnostics remain available for anomaly analysis; only the state-writing gradient is conditioned.
scientific_constraints: This is a stabilized Titans-style recurrence, not an unmodified reproduction of the published Titans update.
The 500-step run is an engineering and exploratory stability test, not evidence of an adaptive-memory benefit.
The selected rho and theta bounds remain hyperparameters and require intervention-frequency and held-out-BPB review before the 25M-base run.
Anomaly evaluation must use held-out data and fixed false-positive-rate thresholds; preconditioning telemetry alone is not an anomaly-utility result.
